journey.name: Trip Price Calculation - Safe Zone Traffic
journey.description: Verifies trip price calculation with a 5% traffic surcharge by selecting the 'Safe Zone (+5%)' option for a 10 km, 20 minute trip. Validates that the estimated price calculates to 108 EGP.

actions.action: Tap the "Start" button on the home screen to navigate to the distance entry screen.
Clear the input field, type "10" into the "Distance in kilometers" field, and tap "Next". Verify navigation to "Enter the total time".
Clear the input field, type "20" into the "Time in minutes" field, and tap "Next". Verify navigation to traffic options.
Tap the "Safe Zone (+5%)" radio button option to select it, then tap "Calculate Trip Price".
Verify that the calculated trip price screen displays "108" and the snackbar "Price Calculated Successfully!".
